Job description

Leadership Hiring!! Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) || Faridabad || 15+ years || 40- 50 LPA || Ritu - 9990744966


Note: If you want your CV shortlisted, Copy, Paste and fill out the below form for a better response.

Job Apply Link: https://shorturl.at/0Xtm6


Follow us on WhatsApp to keep yourself updated on "Urgent Vacancies" @ the moment

https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaYZ4fe90x2qXr1AMG0K


Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role


We are looking for an exceptional Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) who is not just a marketing leader but a business growth leader. The ideal candidate will own the complete Sales & Marketing function, build high-performing teams, drive revenue growth, and establish the company as a leading brand in the dry fruits and healthy foods category.


This is a strategic leadership role for someone who has successfully scaled FMCG/Food brands and can combine brand-building with strong commercial execution. Modern CMOs increasingly own both brand growth and revenue outcomes, working closely with sales and business leadership.


Key Responsibilities


* Develop and execute the company's long-term Sales & Marketing strategy.

* Drive revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion across India.

* Build a strong consumer brand through innovative marketing initiatives.

* Lead Brand Marketing, Digital Marketing, Trade Marketing, Performance Marketing, and Product Marketing.

* Develop Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for existing and new product categories.

* Own marketing budgets, business planning, and ROI optimization.

* Lead, mentor, and build high-performing Sales and Marketing teams.

* Identify new business opportunities, distribution channels, and strategic partnerships.

* Drive product launches, pricing strategies, and category expansion.

* Work closely with Production, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales teams to achieve business objectives.

* Analyze market trends, consumer insights, and competitor activities to create sustainable competitive advantages.

* Establish KPIs, monitor business performance, and drive continuous improvement.

* Represent the company with key customers, distributors, investors, and strategic partners.


Candidate Profile:


* 15+ years of leadership experience in FMCG, Food, Dry Fruits, Snacks, Consumer Goods, or related industries.

* Proven track record of scaling brands and driving significant revenue growth.

* Strong expertise in Sales Leadership, Brand Building, Marketing Strategy, and Business Development.

* Experience handling large teams and leading cross-functional departments.

* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P&L, budgets, and growth strategies.

* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

* MBA in Marketing or Business Management preferred.


What We're Looking For


* Visionary Business Leader.

* Revenue & Growth Oriented Mindset.

* Strong Team Builder & Mentor.

* Strategic Thinker with Execution Excellence.

* Passionate About Building Scalable Consumer Brands.


Companies to target: Haldiram's, Bikaji Foods, LT Foods, Tata Consumer Products, ITC Foods, PepsiCo India, Parle Products, Britannia Industries, Marico, Dabur India, Adani Wilmar, Patanjali Foods, Wingreens, Farmley, Happilo, Nutraj, Rostaa, California Walnuts India, True Elements, Yoga Bar

Interested candidates can apply or share their updated CVs at
